provenance.method: universe: census code subjects (coordination/practice surfaces excluded — they co-change with every lane by construction). co-change: git log 12 months, sweep commits excluded (>5 subjects touched), subjects mapped by longest census dirPath, pairs with >=5 shared commits, union-find at strength thresholds (shared / min(commits)); imports: committed census facts.json sourceDependencies (depcruise-derived), substrate separation at in-degree >=8, deterministic label propagation over the residual graph (sorted order, max 20 iterations)

design.proposal: Organisation derived purely from measured change-coupling: units that changed together in >=50% of their commits over 12 months belong in one unit. Method: git co-change union-find at 0.5, pairs with >=5 shared commits. Units not listed form no measured grouping and stand alone. Grouped units: [agent-tools, packages/core/result]; [apps/oak-curriculum-mcp-streamable-http, packages/libs/logger, packages/sdks/oak-curriculum-sdk]; [apps/oak-search-cli, packages/sdks/oak-sdk-codegen, packages/sdks/oak-search-sdk]; [demos/oak-curriculum-hub, demos/oak-design-showcase, packages/libs/fidelity-review]; [packages/core/graph-core, packages/libs/graph-ingest, packages/libs/graph-project].
design.notes: Derived from 1843 commits; thresholds 0.7 and 0.85 give 3 and 2 groups respectively. No model judgement involved.

design.proposal: Organisation derived purely from the measured import graph: a shared SUBSTRATE tier (units imported by >= 8 others: packages/core/oak-eslint, packages/core/observability, packages/core/result, packages/core/type-helpers, packages/core/workspace-config) beneath residual clusters of units that import each other. Method: hub separation at in-degree >= 8, then label propagation over residual depcruise workspace-level edges. Units not listed form no measured grouping and stand alone. Grouped units: [agent-tools, apps/oak-curriculum-mcp-streamable-http, apps/oak-search-cli, demos/oak-curriculum-hub, demos/oak-design-showcase, packages/core/build-metadata, packages/core/env, packages/core/openapi-zod-client-adapter, packages/core/safe-path, packages/design/oak-design-react, packages/design/oak-design-system, packages/libs/env-resolution, packages/libs/fidelity-review, packages/libs/logger, packages/libs/posthog-node, packages/libs/search-contracts, packages/libs/sentry-node, packages/sdks/graph-corpus-sdk, packages/sdks/oak-curriculum-sdk, packages/sdks/oak-sdk-codegen, packages/sdks/oak-search-sdk]; [packages/core/graph-core, packages/libs/graph-ingest, packages/libs/graph-project]; [packages/design/design-tokens-core, packages/design/oak-design-ink, packages/design/oak-design-tokens].
design.notes: Derived from 146 workspace-level import edges (47 residual after substrate separation). No model judgement involved.
